audit.whatIsWrong: Level 3 was given to Yone under a why that says 'Level 3 is yours', and both item rows were given to Yone under whys calling them even and skill-dependent. Separately whys[4] said level 6 stays with Yone while the row, phases[4].why and the packet all give it to Tryndamere.
audit.why: packet.levelChart is [Tryndamere, Skill, Tryndamere, Yone, Tryndamere, Skill, Skill]; Tryndamere wins 53.88% over 2400 games, which a chart giving Yone four rows cannot support.
audit.corrected: Row 2 flipped to Tryndamere and rows 5-6 to Skill in both layers with ratings; whys[4] rewritten to agree with its own row rather than the chart being bent to it.

audit.why: Yone's window is 4-5 on stacked Mortal Steel plus Soul Unbound's safe return; yours are level 3 before his knockup is reliable and level 6 with Undying Rage. Item timings genuinely even out, which is what the packet chart shows.

audit.whatIsWrong: Soul Unbound, Spirit Cleave and Mortal Steel all appeared without cooldowns, and the damage-repeat on Soul Unbound's return was described only as 'he snaps back'.
audit.why: Riot kit: Soul Unbound is 22/19/16/13/10s and on ending forces his spirit back to the body, repeating a portion of the damage he dealt as a spirit — so standing in that area when it expires is what actually hurts. Spirit Cleave is 14s and shields him. Mortal Steel is a flat 4s and needs two Gathering Storm stacks before it becomes the dashing knockup, so his engage is countable.
audit.corrected: Rewrote dosFull[0].d, dosFull[2].d, dontsFull[0].d and dontsFull[1].d with the cooldowns and the return-damage mechanic.
